clips.title: 增长放缓：反而利好美债？，汇丰称消费动能转弱

subtitles.en: Is there the possibility of, you know, some kind of combustion next week?
subtitles.zh: 下周是否有可能出现某种波动？

subtitles.en: So markets right now have taken this announcement from Bessent with a little bit of skepticism, but then he had to come out and say, no, but we have a bigger plan.
subtitles.zh: 市场对贝森特的声明持怀疑态度，但他随后表示，我们还有更大的计划。

subtitles.en: I promise you, there is a bigger plan. We're going to get to this step mountain and the US can do it.
subtitles.zh: 我保证，有更大的计划。我们将逐步推进，美国能够做到。

subtitles.en: If we don't get details of that, does this narrative start to take over everything else and become the real focal point for the Treasury market?
subtitles.zh: 如果细节未公布，这一叙事是否会主导其他因素，成为美债市场的焦点？

subtitles.en: Never mind the supply, never mind the competition from AI debt. The fact that we're not addressing this.
subtitles.zh: 暂且不论供应和AI相关债务的竞争，问题在于我们未解决这一议题。

subtitles.en: No, I don't think so. I think we've been here before, right?
subtitles.zh: 不，我不这么认为。我们以前也遇到过类似情况，对吧？

subtitles.en: We've been here before in the last three, three and a half years. It's not like the fiscal issue, the debt issue has gone away.
subtitles.zh: 过去三年半里我们经历过类似局面。财政和债务问题并未消失。

subtitles.en: It's not like it's a US issue alone. It's pretty similar in the Eurozone, pretty similar to what we are seeing in Japan, right?
subtitles.zh: 这并非美国独有的问题。欧元区和日本的情况也类似。

subtitles.en: It's a global issue, number one. Number two, we're able to do all that.
subtitles.zh: 首先，这是全球性问题。其次，我们能够应对这些挑战。

subtitles.en: We're able to talk about fiscal and about the issues and about hyperscaler debt so much.
subtitles.zh: 我们能够如此多地讨论财政、问题和超大规模债务。

subtitles.en: Why? Because growth has been so strong. Let's face it, when you look at economic surprise indices, for a very brief period at the end of last year, they dept for like a week or two into negative.
subtitles.zh: 为什么？因为增长一直很强劲。说实话，看经济意外指数，去年年底有很短一段时间，大概一两周，跌入负值。

subtitles.en: But they've been basically on an uninterrupted positive streak for the best part of the last year and a half.
subtitles.zh: 但基本上，过去一年半的大部分时间里，它们一直保持连续的正值。

subtitles.en: What we're seeing right now very clearly is the US, the growth momentum is starting to slow down on the consumption side.
subtitles.zh: 我们现在很清楚地看到，美国的增长动能开始在消费端放缓。

subtitles.en: It's not falling off the cliff, but I think a lot of the positive impulsies, like from the OBBA, for example, like tax refunds, like things like the capex incentives, the immediate expensing of capex,
subtitles.zh: 虽然不是断崖式下跌，但很多正面刺激，比如OBBA、退税、资本开支激励、资本开支即时费用化等，

subtitles.en: you know, a lot of those impulsies have been happening in the second half of the last year
subtitles.zh: 很多这些刺激措施都发生在去年下半年。
en_highlights: second half of the last year
